verdict.rationale: Twenty documents a built-in AI chatbot that answers natural-language questions by querying, summarizing and explaining CRM records. It also documents AI agents that run multi-step tasks such as enriching records within role-scoped permissions, and agents can be driven from chat to use app tools. missing for 10: explicit documentation that general record changes (create/update/delete, views, workflows) can be commanded through chat rather than only queried or run as defined agent tasks, independent or hands-on corroboration.
